record.question: Who is the chairman of Mizoram Youth Commission (MYC)
record.explanation: Answer B: Dr. Vanlaltanpuia. The contemporaneous 2019 report identifies Dr Vanlaltanpuia as the MYC chairman appointed in July 2019; later Mizoram government material also identifies him as chairman. Reference: https://vanglaini.org/tualchhung/25108; https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/grand-celebration-held-in-lunglei-for-mzu-southern-campus. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
